title: Playing Chick Corea's compositions
summary: Recording Corea's music has widened the audience, and he wants more with composers with a broader view without making concessions.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Playing for the audience: communicating from the bandstand

blocks.x: Now, in recent years, capped by the first Chick, Donald, Walter, and side of your current album, (unintelligible) Woodrow, you've Corea's done some wonderful things with Chick Currea's compositions. And that seems to have maybe even widened your audience, do you feel that?

Oh, yeah, I want to do -- I would like to be able to continue to do more and more of this, with different composers and different people, people who had a broader view. And I feel still haven't made any musical concessions, to any great degree.
Now, I would love to be a part of their music.
